bullets.text: Fifteen staff work in fear as the wildlife division office in Velachery is at risk of collapsing due to a lack of renovation funds, so the office should inspect the building.
The meteorological department clarified doubts after rumors spread that the radar instrument near Chennai Fort was not working during the monsoon, and the office should note the weather update.
An individual opposed releasing surplus water from the Jyothi Nagar lake in Tiruttani following continuous rain, and the office should monitor the local drainage and flood response.
Twenty-five Irula tribal women in Pulicat gained a new livelihood through ornamental fish rearing, earning one lakh rupees, and the office should support and promote similar rural initiatives.
Sathiyam News reported on Black October as a new AI risk causing concern in the IT world, and the office should monitor potential impacts on technology jobs.
Visakhapatnam shows signs of transformation in its IT space with talent and new investments, and the office should study these regional growth trends.
Prof Thillai Rajan highlighted that the Indian startup ecosystem suffers from a lack of reliable data, and the office should watch for democratization efforts.
